clues.text: Agur listed this strutting creature with a lion, a he-goat and a king as stately in their walk.
Jesus urged His disciples to keep watch: the master may return at evening, midnight, when this calls, or morning.
When Peter vowed to lay down his life for Jesus, Jesus warned of three denials before this crowed.
In the high priest's courtyard, Peter denied Jesus to a servant girl, went out to the gateway, and this crowed.
As this crowed while Peter was still speaking his denial, the Lord turned and looked at Peter.
It crowed right after a relative of the man whose ear Peter cut off asked about the garden.
After Peter cursed and swore he did not know the man, this crowed, and he went out weeping bitterly.
